{{Top|leg}}
A '''decoy system''' was used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to give off a false [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] reading, making the scanners believe the ship was a different size.

On his approach to [[Coronet/Legends|Coronet]] to meet with [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] forgot to deactivate his decoy system, and the [[Corellian Traffic Control|Corellian Air Traffic Control]] detected [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] as a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] on their displays.
